title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Mixed Figure — Library Use and Study Space Satisfaction
prompt:
The figure below shows information about a public library in the town of Marlow. The bar chart compares the number of visits to four library services in 2015 and 2023, and the table shows the percentage of library users who rated each of the same four services as 'satisfied' in those two years.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先看清混合图的两部分：柱状图显示2015年与2023年四项服务的到访次数，表格显示同两年用户对四项服务的满意度百分比。写作时先概述总体趋势，再选取关键数据进行对比，注意单位（visits 与 %）不要混淆。不要表达个人观点或解释原因，只描述和比较图中信息。建议用约20分钟，写不少于150词。
